name: George Corey
summary: George Corey was a Dunwich farmer whose hired boy Luther worked his land near Cold Spring Glen and first raised the alarm over the horror's tracks.
description: George Corey was the farmer, between Cold Spring Glen and the village, at whose place Luther Brown worked as hired boy; George's wife, Mrs. Corey, lived down by the junction.

sources.quote: About 7 o'clock Luther Brown, the hired boy at George Corey's, between Cold Spring Glen and the village, rushed frenziedly back from his morning trip to Ten-Acre Meadow with the cows.
it was Mis' Corey, George's wife that lives daown by the junction

facts: Luther Brown was the hired boy at his farm, between Cold Spring Glen and the village.
His wife is Mrs. Corey, who lives down by the junction.
